families.referenceCue: Pale blue clouded sky surrounding the fitted roof silhouette. Wash question: one flowing light cool passage with merging same-passage wet edges; cloud lights remain paper, no isolated outlined cloud tiles.

Tall left chimney: ochre lit right face and cooler shaded left face. Broad wall wash, dry mid planes, a connected shadow glaze crossing the chimney band and adjacent wall. Fine vertical flues belong to closing ink.

Receding left wing is darker and greyer than the central sunlit gable. Connected warm stone planes on dry paper; cool window and door recesses are late controlled paint accents. Sparse mullions and cornice junctions are ink-and-wash detail.

Focal golden gable with four narrow upper lancets, two paired Gothic arches, lower windows and two street-level arches. Keep the lit left corner and pale arch surrounds light. Broad transparent warm wash, dry fitted mid planes, restrained tooth texture, then connected shadow glazing across sill, wall and openings. Thin mullions and arch ribs use selective closing sepia.
Blue-grey sloping slate roof behind the central gable. Connected cool value plane, hard fitted ridge and eave, a few late joints; no individual tile stipple.
Right chimney has a cool shaded face and a narrow sunlit golden face. Light wash then dry side plane and cross-band shadow glaze; flues and cap junctions are selective ink detail.

Right background wing: warm walls with blue window groups beneath the diagonal slate roof. Wash question for walls and roof; ink-and-wash question for thin window divisions. Keep fitted openings crisp on measured dry paper.

Low foreground annex: light roof and cornice over golden walls and narrow cool recesses. Pale planes first; roof cast shadow later crosses the cornice, wall and windows. Preserve light sill edges; close only the hard junctions.

Yellow-green tree interrupts the central facade at lower right. Connected irregular canopy wash with light sky and wall gaps; dry connected shadow groups, a few crisp shaped foliage edges and tapering trunk accents. No equal leaf disks or canopy stipple.

Muted green planting and tiny figures at the lower left: connected wash and shadow mass, subordinate to the central architecture. Small human silhouettes are late dry value accents; grass and leaf strands are below wash resolution.

Blue sign, pale lamp shaft and dark traffic signal beside the gable. Dry connected local planes and late controlled darks. Sign letter strokes and lamp contours are selective thin drawing, not broad dark ink fills.
